description: This Java class, ClientPersonWorkbookPopulator, is responsible for generating and populating an Excel workbook with client person data, including setting up sheets, formatting, data validation rules, and lookup tables for importing client data into a system. It extends an abstract populator, interacts with multiple other classes for populating specific sheets, and defines methods for layout, data validation, and reference setup.

classes.name: ClientPersonWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: A class responsible for populating an Excel workbook with client person data, including setting up sheets, applying styles, data validation, and lookup reference tables for bulk import purposes.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to populate the Excel workbook with client data, sheets layout, formatting, and validation rules, using the provided date format.

methods.name: setFormatStyle
methods.description: Applies date formatting styles to specific columns across all data rows.

methods.name: setFormatActivationAndSubmittedDate
methods.description: Sets date format style to a specific cell in a row.

methods.name: setClientDataLookupTable
methods.description: Populates lookup data for client types, classifications, gender, address types, state/provinces, and countries into the sheet.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Creates header row and defines column widths and header titles for the client person sheet.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines data validation rules for various columns, including dropdowns and date constraints.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Defines named ranges for lookup lists and staff options to be referenced in data validation.
